chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from 'Abbas ibn 'Amir, who said: 'Abdullah ibn 'Ubayd al-Anbari informed me,

I said to Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'May I be sacrificed for you, verily it is not every year that means are prepared for me to go out with for Hajj.' He said: 'When you desire Hajj and means are not prepared for you, go to the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), for verily it will be registered for you as a Hajj. And when you desire 'Umrah and means are not prepared for you, go to the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), for verily it will be registered for you as an 'Umrah.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam Husayn's grave if one cannot afford Hajj?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.), highlighting the spiritual economy of the Ahl al-Bayt where the merit of Ziyarah to Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) is equated to the Hajj al-Mabrur for those unable to travel. This ruling underscores the concept of 'Hajj al-Bada'il' (replacing missed obligations) through devotion to the Imams, a key theme in Shia jurisprudence for compensating for physical or financial limitations. The narration emphasizes that the spiritual presence and reward at Karbala can substitute for the physical journey to Mecca, reinforcing the centrality of the Imams in the believer's religious practice.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Mughīrah, from ‘Abbās ibn ‘Āmir, from ‘Abdillāh ibn ‘Ubayd Al-Anbāri, who said:

I said to Abī ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)), “May I sacrifice myself for you! I do not have the means to go to Hajj every year.” Imam (a.s.) replied: If you ever wanted to go to Hajj but did not have the means (to do so), go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.), for verily it will be registered as a Hajj for you. And if you ever wanted to go for ‘Umrah but did not have the means (to do so), go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.), for verily it will be registered as an ‘Umrah for you.
